description: Search Korean administrative rules in force (행정규칙: notices 고시, directives 훈령, established rules 예규, guidelines 지침, etc.) by words in the rule name (type, ministry, issue and effective dates). Search terms must be in Korean. Use this first when you do not know the official rule name. Note that administrative rules are internal standards of government agencies, not laws (Acts or Decrees).

query.description: Korean words in the rule name. E.g. 소비자분쟁해결기준

name: search_rule
title: Search administrative rules (행정규칙 검색)
